# Repository Coding Instructions

Use `AGENTS.md` as the primary instructions for this repository. Read the relevant files under
`agents/`, `rules/`, and `skills/` before acting on a task. Treat `README.md`, `docs/`, runbooks,
schemas, and tests as the source of truth. Work read-only by default and require explicit human
approval before Kubernetes, Helm, Helmfile, Kustomize, Terraform, CI/CD, or other state-changing
operations.

Read `AI_PROMPT.md` for the portable model-neutral prompt and `AI_GUIDANCE.md` for the complete
guidance map. Read `AI_DESIGN.md` only for frontend or visual-design tasks.
